decision_rationale: The record presents a new model, LOL-EVE, as a conditional autoregressive transformer trained on 14.6 million mammalian promoter sequences. It is used to generate and score promoter sequences and is described as a large genomic language model with broad evolutionary training data.
evidence_snippet: "conditional autoregressive transformer model trained on 14.6 million diverse mammalian promoter sequences"; "learns a generative model over full promoter nucleotide sequences"; "broad evolutionary patterns"; "region-specific large genomic language models"
